title: Relm CRM
description: API-first CRM for LLMs - contacts, companies, deals and activities over a native MCP server.
summary: API-first CRM for LLMs - contacts, companies, deals and activities over a native MCP server.
offersHint: API-first CRM for LLMs - contacts, companies, deals and activities over a native MCP server. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.relmcrm.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: relm_describe_schema
toolsPreview.description: Return the live schema: every object, its fields (built-in + custom), and all enum groups with their current values (contact types, activity types, etc). ALWAYS call this before guessing a type, stage, or field - it is the source of truth for what exists.

toolsPreview.name: relm_search
toolsPreview.description: Cross-entity search over contacts, companies and deals by name/email/title.

toolsPreview.name: relm_list
toolsPreview.description: List records of an object with keyset pagination. Optional filters vary by object (e.g. contact: email/company_id/type; deal: pipeline/stage/company_id; activity: contact_id/deal_id/type).

toolsPreview.name: relm_get
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one record by id.

toolsPreview.name: relm_create
toolsPreview.description: Create a record. `data` is the object's fields (see relm_describe_schema). Custom fields must be registered first (relm_create_field). A contact needs at least one of: a name, an identifier (email/phone/linkedin_url), a company, or a custom field (email is unique per workspace) - don't invent a placeholder email.

toolsPreview.name: relm_update
toolsPreview.description: Patch a record. Pass if_match (the record's current version) for optimistic concurrency; a 412 means re-fetch and retry.

toolsPreview.name: relm_delete
toolsPreview.description: Soft-delete a record (recoverable via relm_restore). Never hard-destroys data.

toolsPreview.name: relm_restore
toolsPreview.description: Restore a soft-deleted record.

toolsPreview.name: relm_log_activity
toolsPreview.description: Log an activity (note/call/email/meeting/task) on a contact and/or deal. Convenience wrapper over create activity.

toolsPreview.name: relm_list_pipelines
toolsPreview.description: List pipelines with their ordered stages.

toolsPreview.name: relm_create_pipeline
toolsPreview.description: Create a pipeline. Optionally provide stages [{key,label}] (defaults to lead/qualified/proposal/won/lost) and is_default.

toolsPreview.name: relm_manage_stage
toolsPreview.description: Add, rename/retype, delete, or reorder stages in a pipeline. action=add: `key` (+optional label, ordinal, type). action=rename: `key` (existing) + any of new_key / label / type - keys are slugified and deals follow automatically (fixes a typo'd key). action=delete: `key` (a stage in use by deals cannot be deleted). action=reorder: `order` = every existing stage key exactly once, in the new order. `type` is the semantic stage type: open | won | lost - so 'is this deal won?' is a flag (stage_type on every deal), not per-pipeline string matching.

toolsPreview.name: relm_create_type
toolsPreview.description: Register a new object type in the schema (registry). Idempotent on key; returns the full type set.

toolsPreview.name: relm_create_field
toolsPreview.description: Register a new custom field on an object (contact/company/deal/activity). data_type: text|number|boolean|date|select|multiselect|currency|reference|email|url. Must be created before it can be written to a record.

toolsPreview.name: relm_create_enum_value
toolsPreview.description: Add a value to an enum group (e.g. group 'contact.type' value 'partner'). Idempotent; returns the full value set. Use this when relm_create rejects an unknown type with a valid_options list.

toolsPreview.name: relm_batch
toolsPreview.description: Run up to 100 record writes in ONE call (contact/company/deal/activity) - the fast path for imports/migrations. operations: [{object, method:create|update|delete, data|patch, id?}]. Returns a per-op result array (partial success). Every op still counts against your quota (batch saves round-trips, not quota).

toolsPreview.name: relm_automations_capabilities
toolsPreview.description: Discover the automation building blocks: valid trigger_events, condition ops, action types, channels/providers, and the shapes of automations/sequences/connections. Call before building a rule or sequence.

toolsPreview.name: relm_connect_channel
toolsPreview.description: Connect a BYO messaging channel so automations can send. channel='email', provider='resend', api_key=<your Resend key>, from='Team <hi@you.com>' (must be a verified Resend sender). The key is encrypted at rest.

toolsPreview.name: relm_list_connections
toolsPreview.description: List connected messaging channels (never returns the secret key).

toolsPreview.name: relm_create_automation
toolsPreview.description: Create a single-step rule: when <trigger_event> [if <conditions>] then <actions>. conditions=[{field,op,value}] (ANDed), actions=[{type,...}]. Example: trigger_event='deal.stage_changed', conditions=[{field:'stage',op:'eq',value:'won'}], actions=[{type:'create_activity',body:'Deal won!'}]. See relm_automations_capabilities.

toolsPreview.name: relm_list_automations
toolsPreview.description: List reactive rules (automations).

toolsPreview.name: relm_create_template
toolsPreview.description: Create a reusable email template. name, html (full HTML, {{field}} placeholders ok), optional subject + text (plaintext alt; auto-derived if omitted). Reference it from a rule/sequence step via {"type":"send_email","template":"<key or tmpl_id>"}.

toolsPreview.name: relm_list_templates
toolsPreview.description: List reusable email templates.

toolsPreview.name: relm_create_sequence
toolsPreview.description: Create a multi-step drip sequence. trigger={event,filter:[{field,op,value}]} auto-enrolls the matching entity's contact; exit_when=[{field,op,value}] stops it (re-checked before every send); steps=[{wait_days,subject,body}] (first step wait_days:0 sends now). enroll_existing:true also enrolls everything that currently matches. Example: 3 emails to contacts of deals entering stage 'lead', stop if the deal leaves 'lead'.

toolsPreview.name: relm_list_sequences
toolsPreview.description: List drip sequences with their steps and enrollment counts.

toolsPreview.name: relm_preview_sequence
toolsPreview.description: Dry-run a sequence: how many contacts would enroll now + the send schedule. No side effects.

toolsPreview.name: relm_enroll
toolsPreview.description: Manually enroll a contact into a sequence (idempotent per contact+sequence). Optional source={object,id} records what drove the enrollment (e.g. a deal).

toolsPreview.name: relm_create_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Subscribe an https endpoint to CRM events. events=['*'] for all, or a subset of ['contact.created','contact.updated','deal.created','deal.updated','deal.stage_changed']. Returns a `secret` ONCE - the subscriber verifies the `Relm-Signature` header (t=<unix>,v1=<hmac-sha256 of "t.body">). Deliveries retry with backoff and dead-letter after 6 attempts.

toolsPreview.name: relm_list_webhooks
toolsPreview.description: List webhook subscriptions in this workspace/mode.

toolsPreview.name: relm_delete_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Delete a webhook subscription by id.

toolsPreview.name: relm_get_automation
toolsPreview.description: Read one automation by id, with its trigger, conditions and actions.

toolsPreview.name: relm_get_sequence
toolsPreview.description: Read one drip sequence by id. view=sequence (default) returns it with its steps; view=enrollments lists who is enrolled and their state.

toolsPreview.name: relm_get_pipeline
toolsPreview.description: Read one pipeline by key or pl_ id, with its ordered stages and their semantic types (open/won/lost).

toolsPreview.name: relm_get_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Read one webhook by id. view=webhook (default) returns the subscription; view=deliveries returns recent delivery attempts (status, retries, dead-letter) to debug why an endpoint isn't receiving events.

toolsPreview.name: relm_manage_automation
toolsPreview.description: Change an existing automation by id. action=disable stops it firing (use this to turn off a misbehaving rule); action=enable resumes it; action=delete removes it. To read one, use relm_get_automation. To change a rule's trigger/conditions/actions, delete and recreate.

toolsPreview.name: relm_manage_sequence
toolsPreview.description: Change an existing drip sequence by id. action=disable stops further sends (use this to halt a bad sequence); action=enable resumes; action=delete removes it. To read one or list its enrollments, use relm_get_sequence.

toolsPreview.name: relm_manage_pipeline
toolsPreview.description: Change an existing pipeline by key or pl_ id. action=rename changes its display `name` and/or its key (pass `new_key`) - deals link by internal id, so they follow a re-key automatically; action=set_default makes it the workspace default; action=delete removes it (fails if deals still use it - move them first). To read one, use relm_get_pipeline.

toolsPreview.name: relm_manage_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Pause or resume delivery for an existing webhook by id. action=enable/disable. To read one or inspect its delivery attempts, use relm_get_webhook. To remove it, use relm_delete_webhook.

toolsPreview.name: relm_delete_connection
toolsPreview.description: Delete a connected messaging channel by id (e.g. to remove a rotated/wrong Resend key).

toolsPreview.name: relm_get_usage
toolsPreview.description: Read this workspace's current billing period: requests used, plan, monthly limit, and any metered overage. Call this to see how close you are to the quota before a big import.

toolsPreview.name: relm_set_spend_cap
toolsPreview.description: Set (or clear) the hard monthly overage spend cap in USD. overage_cap_usd: a number caps paid overage (requests 429 with spend_cap_reached past it), 0 = never any overage, null = unlimited. This is the recovery for a spend_cap_reached error.
